patterns.note: Sections are often delineated by large, organic 'cloud' shapes or waves, breaking the typical rectangular grid and adding a playful, soft aesthetic.
A vibrant, almost electric blue is used as a dominant brand color for backgrounds and accents, creating high contrast with white text and product imagery.
Large, bold, and slightly rounded sans-serif headings are used for section titles, conveying a friendly and energetic brand voice.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
The main navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background as it becomes sticky at the top of the page.
A persistent 'Get a Taste of the Sweety Life' email signup module appears and sticks to the bottom-left of the screen after initial scroll depth.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up effect as they enter the viewport.
The main navigation bar uses a sticky positioning technique, transitioning its background color and height to a more compact state after the user scrolls past the hero section.
Interactive elements and illustrations, such as the mochi character, are likely animated using Lottie, adding a dynamic and playful feel to the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, playful display headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable sans-serif body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, product cards, and section background shapes (cloud-like), giving a soft, friendly feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, with a balanced density within content blocks like product grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost electric blue as a primary brand color, combined with playful cloud-like shapes and a charming mochi character, creates a unique and memorable aesthetic. This whimsical visual language, applied consistently across product cards and section dividers, elevates it beyond a typical food product site, making it feel approachable and fun.
